opsd.label: Compared with the full-pool control
opsd.explanation: The final 32-example setting scores above the 100-step full-pool OPSD control.
opsd.context: The search scores a fixed pool of 9,600 candidates. Every round starts from the initial student in the reference configuration; earlier checkpoints inform subsequent selection.
opsd.protocol: All displayed trained settings report 100 optimizer steps. Selection and prior rounds add compute: the first two cycles report approximately 8–14 GPU-hours, excluding the final aggressive round. The selector and artifacts are withheld; step/epoch semantics require clarification. Scores average three evaluation seeds, not three independent training runs.

evolver.metric: Eight-set full-test mean · 3,000-row SFT per trained arm
evolver.label: Compared with DataFlow's expert-authored Math-3K
evolver.explanation: DataFlow-Evolver improves over the Qwen2.5-7B base and the matched GPT-4o rewrite, but remains below DataFlow's expert-authored Math-3K reference.
evolver.context: Math-3K is the 3,000-row Math subset of DataFlow-Instruct-10K, produced by DataFlow's human-authored DataFlow Math pipeline over MATH and GSM8K training data. This run evolves a pipeline over a fixed 14,181-row mixture of the official MATH and GSM8K training sets, decontaminated against downstream test files with normalized 13-gram matching. The GPT-4o reference reruns the official pipeline with the same pipeline LLM used by DataFlow-Evolver.
evolver.protocol: The headline is the eight-set full-test mean. A fixed 10% diagnostic sample from each test file supplied in-loop feedback; because those examples are included in the final full-test set, the headline is not a fully untouched evaluation. Pipeline evolution took 3h 31m 57s of effective runtime across five iterations. Including checkpoint_000 baseline evaluation and checkpoint_002/004 SFT plus diagnostic evaluation, total effective runtime was 4h 30m 05s. The wall-clock span was approximately 6h 07m, including about 1h 37m of waiting and scheduling gaps; pipeline time is not converted to GPU-hours because its service GPU occupancy was not archived. Public release of the full upstream implementation and original run artifacts is in preparation; links will follow.

self.metric: Seven-set transfer mean · Final corpus: 6,000 rows
self.label: Compared with the base model
self.explanation: The final refined corpus improves the reported transfer mean, with a non-monotonic trajectory.
self.context: Validation failures guide changes to the pipeline and corpus. The final set contains 6,000 rows; a preceding merge reached 7,000.
self.protocol: MATH-500 and AIME26 are described as in-loop probes and excluded from the seven-set headline. Seed records are 42,42,44; run identities and actual rollback evidence require clarification. Compute and original artifacts are pending. This seven-set mean is not directly comparable to the Evolver eight-set mean.
